messages.speaker: them
messages.text: TCS parcel service se call hai. Aap ka naam par London se parcel aaya hai jis mein currency hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Parcel? Maine kuch order nahi kiya.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Customs ne rok rakha hai. Release ke liye 6,200 customs duty foran jama karni hai.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Ye agent number hai Easypaisa par: 0333-XXXXX12, reference parcel LC-8891 likh dein.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Duty office se payment hoti thi na pehle?

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Naya online system hai. 2 ghante ke andar fee na hui to parcel customs custody mein chale ga aur fine lage ga.
